    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersShrek's onion ringsButtermilk soaked onion rings in a panko crust, barbecue mayo dipHow to make it3 brown onions300ml buttermilk100g plain flour2 eggs150g panko breadcrumbs1 L vegetable oil100g mayonnaise3 tbsp barbecue sauceCut the onions into thick rings and soak in the buttermilk.Soak.Dredge in flour, dip in beaten egg and press into panko.Fry in the oil at 180°C in batches until deep golden.Mix the mayonnaise and barbecue sauce to dip.Swamp dipHot baked spinach, artichoke and cream cheese dip with corn chipsHow to make it250g spinach1 jar artichoke hearts250g cream cheese100g sour cream50g parmesan2 garlic cloves100g mozzarella1 bag corn chipsWilt the spinach, squeeze dry and chop.Mix with chopped artichokes, cream cheese, sour cream, parmesan and crushed garlic.Top with mozzarella and bake at 200°C until bubbling.Serve with corn chips.Gingy's gumdrop button gingerbread menGingy keeps his buttons, you get yoursHow to make itAs written, serves 4Soft spiced gingerbread men piped with white icing smiles and finished with bright gumdrop buttons, one with a leg snapped off for the fans.Melt 125g butter, 100g brown sugar and 100g golden syrup.Stir into 350g plain flour, 2 tsp ground ginger, 1 tsp cinnamon and 1 tsp bicarb soda with 1 egg.Chill 1 hour, roll 5mm thick and cut gingerbread men.Bake at 180°C for 10 minutes and cool.Pipe faces with icing from 100g icing sugar and lemon juice, and stick on gumdrops as buttons.Smoked eel on rye with horseradishCaught the Shrek way, in the mud bath.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsSwamp stewBeef chuck braised 3 hours with tomato paste and Worcestershire, peas, spinachHow to make it1kg beef chuck2 brown onions3 garlic cloves2 celery sticks2 tbsp tomato paste2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce750ml beef stock200g frozen peas100g spinach1 crusty loafDice the beef, onions, garlic and celery.Brown the beef in batches, then soften the vegetables.Add the tomato paste, Worcestershire sauce and stock, return the beef, cover and braise at 160°C.Stir in the peas and spinach for the last 5 minutes so it turns green. Serve with crusty bread.Lord Farquaad's Duloc roast chickenFarquaad's perfect, tidy kingdom of DulocHow to make itAs written, serves 4Chicken marylands rubbed with garlic, rosemary and lemon, roasted golden in perfectly neat rows with crispy potatoes and a sharp herb salsa verde.Rub 4 chicken marylands with 2 crushed garlic cloves, chopped rosemary, lemon zest, oil and salt.Toss 1kg diced potatoes with oil.Lay the chicken and potatoes in neat rows on a tray and roast at 200°C for 50 minutes until the chicken reaches 75°C.Chop parsley, mint, capers and 1 garlic clove and mix with 80ml olive oil and lemon juice.Spoon over to serve.SweetsDonkey's wafflesButtermilk waffles with whipped cream, strawberries and maple syrupHow to make it250g plain flour2 tsp baking powder400ml buttermilk2 eggs80g butter300ml thickened cream250g strawberriesmaple syrup, to serveSeparate the eggs. Whisk the flour, baking powder, buttermilk, egg yolks and melted butter.Whip the whites to soft peaks and fold through.Cook in a hot waffle iron until crisp, in batches.Whip the cream, slice the strawberries and serve with maple syrup.DrinksSwamp juiceGreen apple, cucumber, lime and mint blitzed with honey and iceHow to make it3 green apples1 Lebanese cucumber3 limes1 bunch mint2 tbsp honey2 cups iceCore and chop the apples and cucumber.Blitz with the lime juice, mint, honey and ice until slushy.Pour into four glasses and serve straight away with a mint sprig.
